model.label: GigaWorld-Policy-0.6
model.evaluationSetting: 26 tasks, four channels, 50 episodes per task/channel; fixed checkpoint across all tasks

protocol.expertReference: Native per-episode expert_time_step, in physics steps.
protocol.protocolChanges: Custom GWP model integration and Drive v5 IK/execution adapter; robot_base EEF80 actions; prediction/execution horizon 32. Native physics budgets, seeds and stable-success dwell recorded in logs. All 60 scored IK failures remain in denominators; no scored episodes replaced. Native shards were merged into 50-episode task/channel outputs for the original submission export. Exact historical worker benchmark commits are not asserted.

aggregation.sr: 100 * successes / episodes per task/channel; equal channel mean per task; equal task mean over all 26 tasks.
aggregation.lscr: 100 * mean native latched_stage_completion_rate including failures; equal channel and task means.
aggregation.efficiency: Per task, expert_time_step divided by mean steps_to_stable_success pooled over successful episodes from all four channels. Overall is the mean of valid task efficiencies.
aggregation.errors: All 60 scored IK errors retained; 5200 episodes, 2671 successes.
